title: ChefOnline Digital Marketing
imageAlt: ChefOnline digital marketing case study by GTech Digital
excerpt: Joined-up social media and paid campaigns that keep ChefOnline in front of the right audience all year.
challenge: ChefOnline is a UK online ordering platform that lets restaurants and takeaways take orders directly, without paying marketplace commission. Its marketing ran in bursts, with posts and ads planned one at a time, so reach rose and fell and it was hard to tell which activity actually brought people in.
solution: We built a year-round marketing plan for ChefOnline: a content calendar for Facebook and Instagram, paid campaigns aimed at clearly defined audiences, consistent branded creative and tracking on every campaign so spend could be moved to what worked.
results: A steady, planned flow of content instead of one-off posts
Paid campaigns targeted at clearly defined audiences
Consistent branding across every channel
Every campaign tracked, so budget follows what works

title: ChefOnline SEO
imageAlt: ChefOnline SEO case study by GTech Digital
excerpt: Technical fixes, focused content and local SEO to help ChefOnline get found on Google by the people searching for it.
challenge: ChefOnline is a UK online ordering platform that lets restaurants and takeaways take orders directly, without paying marketplace commission. Important pages were not ranking for the searches its audience makes, and technical issues made it harder for Google to crawl and understand the site.
solution: We audited the ChefOnline website, fixed crawl, speed and indexing issues, mapped keywords to the right pages, rewrote titles and content around real search intent, added structured data and built local and industry citations.
results: Technical SEO issues found and fixed
Each key page focused on clear search terms
Structured data added for richer Google results
A content plan to keep growing search visibility

title: ChefOnline Web Development
imageAlt: ChefOnline web development case study by GTech Digital
excerpt: A fast, mobile-first website for ChefOnline, built to be easy to manage and to turn visitors into enquiries.
challenge: ChefOnline is a UK online ordering platform that lets restaurants and takeaways take orders directly, without paying marketplace commission. The website needed to work well on phones, load quickly and make the next step obvious for visitors, while staying easy for the team to update.
solution: We designed and developed a new website for ChefOnline: a clear page structure, mobile-first layouts, fast-loading pages, simple content management and clear calls to action on every page, with analytics set up from launch.
results: Mobile-first design that works on every screen
Fast-loading pages
Content the team can update without a developer
Clear calls to action and analytics from day one

title: ChefOnline App Development
imageAlt: ChefOnline app development case study by GTech Digital
excerpt: A branded food ordering app for iPhone, published on the App Store, so customers can order directly from their phone.
challenge: ChefOnline is a UK online ordering platform that lets restaurants and takeaways take orders directly, without paying marketplace commission. Customers increasingly order on their phones, and a mobile website alone could not offer the convenience of an app: saved details, quick reordering and order updates.
solution: We designed and built the ChefOnline customer app and published it on the App Store. Customers can find restaurants, browse menus, order for delivery or collection, pay securely and follow their order. The app connects to the same ordering platform and API as the website, so menus and orders stay in sync.
results: Customer ordering app live on the App Store
Menus, orders and payments in sync with the web platform
Quick reordering with saved customer details
Order status updates for customers

excerpt: A custom web application that brings Salik & Co’s client work, documents and reporting into one secure system.
